title: The First Note
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 8: The First Note. The Keeper has spent his life helping other notes find their place, but he has never had a note of his own. On the turning world he finds one small light — his. The empty sol-key staff appears above him, and he lifts his note up and sets it in the very first slot: Do. Seven more to find, but the song has begun.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #solfege #storytelling
